description: Implementation of a compact logging transport system with file output capabilities, including configuration, log level filtering, file initialization, writing log entries, and session management.

classes.name: CompactTransport
classes.description: A class implementing a compact logging transport with file output support, managing log sessions, writing entries, and closing sessions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CompactTransport instance with optional configuration, setting session start time and log file path.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the log file and directory are initialized, creating session start marker.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a log entry to console and/or file, calculating time delta since last entry.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the log session, writing a session end marker to the log file.
